jobs.title: Strategy & Planning Associate
jobs.description:
Who we are

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.

About the role

Supports strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives through data-driven analysis, go-to-market strategy development, and cross-functional program execution. Partners with product, sales, marketing, finance, and operations teams to evaluate market opportunities, optimize commercial strategies, and drive high-priority initiatives from concept through implementation. Delivers actionable recommendations to leadership by combining analytical rigor, business acumen, and operational excellence.

What you’ll do

Go-to-Market Strategy & Commercial Planning

- Support the development and execution of go-to-market strategies for new products, features, partnerships, and market expansions.

- Evaluate customer segments, market opportunities, and competitive dynamics to inform commercialization strategies.

- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to develop recommendations related to pricing, packaging, customer acquisition, and growth initiatives.

- Analyze performance metrics and market feedback to optimize GTM motions and improve business outcomes.

Strategic Analysis & Business Insights

- Perform deep-dive analyses to identify business opportunities, operational challenges, and growth levers.

- Develop hypotheses, conduct quantitative and qualitative research, and present findings and recommendations to leadership.

- Build business cases and financial models to support strategic investments, partnerships, and new initiatives.

- Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive executive decision-making.

Cross-Functional Program Management

- Lead and coordinate strategic initiatives across multiple business functions, ensuring alignment, accountability, and successful execution.

- Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams to drive key company priorities.

- Manage project timelines, dependencies, stakeholder communications, and risk mitigation plans.

- Monitor initiative performance and identify opportunities to improve execution and operational efficiency.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

- Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and scaling challenges across the organization.

- Design and implement operational improvements that enhance business performance and team productivity.

- Establish reporting frameworks, KPIs, and operating rhythms to measure initiative success.

- Drive continuous improvement efforts by leveraging data, stakeholder feedback, and industry best practices.

Executive Reporting & Communication

- Prepare presentations, analyses, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.

- Communicate findings and project updates to stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

- Support leadership in strategic planning, prioritization, and decision-making processes.

What we’re looking for

- 2–5 years of experience in Strategy, Business Operations, Corporate Strategy, Management Consulting, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, GTM Strategy, or related analytical roles.

- Experience supporting commercialization efforts, pricing and packaging initiatives, strategic partnerships, market expansion, or go-to-market execution.

- Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, develop hypotheses, conduct analysis, and deliver actionable recommendations.

- Strong financial modeling, business analysis, and executive communication skills.

- Proven track record of managing cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across multiple teams.

- Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments where priorities evolve quickly.

Preferred Industries & Experience

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

- Management Consulting (McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, Accenture Strategy, LEK, Oliver Wyman, EY-Parthenon, Strategy&)

- Investment Banking

- Private Equity

- Venture Capital

- Corporate Strategy

- Business Operations

- GTM Strategy

- Product Strategy

- Revenue Strategy

- High-Growth Technology or SaaS Companies

- Fintech, Payments, or Marketplace Businesses

Why join us

- Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.

- Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.

- Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our Los Angeles office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $100,000 - $125,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options).

- Company-paid life and disability insurance (short- and long-term).

- Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity.

- Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children.

- Pet insurance discount.

- 401(k).

- Health Savings Account (HSA)

- Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)

- Time Off policies:

- Discretionary vacation days

- 8 paid holidays per year

- Paid sick time

- Paid Bereavement leave

- Paid Parental Leave

Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion.
Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?
